subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Should autoreview accept the linked PR’s exact provider/session member-reference and test-placeholder allowlist while retaining its fail-closed handling for all other credential-shaped values?
rationale: The acceptable syntax boundary determines whether legitimate review bundles proceed without creating a bypass for hard-coded credentials; that policy choice cannot be inferred safely from the issue alone.

options.title: Approve exact allowlist
options.body: Approve only the enumerated safe roots and placeholder literals, with negative coverage proving arbitrary dotted identifiers and real credentials still fail.

options.title: Narrow or reject shapes
options.body: Require a smaller syntax set or a different review-bundle representation if any proposed root can carry a literal credential.

recommendation.title: Approve exact allowlist
recommendation.body: Approve only the enumerated safe roots and placeholder literals, with negative coverage proving arbitrary dotted identifiers and real credentials still fail.
